interpretation.falsificationTest: Predefine reconciliation and cost-allocation rules, then audit every cohort record against broker and provider evidence. Any unexplained missing record, unreconciled outcome or unknown material cost falsifies economic completeness; otherwise report net outcomes and downside tails with sample-size uncertainty, without treating them as proof of profitability.
limitations: Provider cost is unattested; counterfactual fills, costs, FX and margin are unknown. Payoff-tail evidence is absent.
Latency, nonfills, per-side quote freshness and protection/recording completeness are not established. One FAILED provider state does not establish an execution failure or its cause.
No intratrade paths were supplied: giveback is unavailable. Sampled quotes cannot establish a missed winner, exit cause or achievable profit.
Empty closed-row statistics do not establish zero cohort profit or loss. Equity-curve and drawdown evidence are absent.
Counts cover this packet, not all opportunities or today's trading. Linked records outside the observed cohort may recur and must not be summed as new trades.
This historical reconstruction is not prospective qualification, a tested hypothesis or a completed experiment; no reviewed future protocol or economic authority is supplied.
interpretation.nextQuestion: Can a deduplicated, fully reconciled cohort establish all-in net outcomes and downside payoff tails without unresolved economic inputs?
interpretation.requiredEvidence: A stable cohort ledger identifying carry-in and linked records; reconciled orders, fills, nonfills, open and closed positions; gross outcomes, spread, commissions, slippage, financing, FX conversion and attested provider charges with an explicit allocation rule; unresolved records retained rather than excluded.
interpretation.summary: Unvalidated reconstruction-only interpretation; HOLD. This packet records 44 analyses: 38 deferred and 6 rejected, with all rejections labeled SELL_ENTRY_TOO_CLOSE. Its 20 contexts contain 18 WAIT, 1 SELL and 1 UNKNOWN decision; no setups or closed-row statistics are supplied. Costs, payoff tails and complete-cohort performance cannot be assessed. No profitability, execution or activation conclusion is supported.
